note: Healing supplies (PLAN.md W3; user 2026-10-06: a weapon category). Each row is a stack carried in the CONSUMABLE weapon slot (weapon.SupplyItem, one shared scene weapon/Supply.tscn): fire uses one on yourself, aim at someone within reach + fire uses it on them, drop gives the stack away. `max` is the stack size, `heal` the HP restored. Bought at a ShopCounter (its `stock` lists these ids beside weapon ids). Food from a konbini / restaurant / supermarket, medical from a hospital, 'strange' from an adult shop. Adding an item = one row here + its id in a counter's stock.
